purpose: The read-and-write map of an actor's frame, for docs/subsystems/actor-frame-parallel.md step 2: what each part of the process manager's loop over the high actors reads and writes outside its own actor, so that the parts that may run on several threads can be told from those that may not. Map and refute only; nothing is rebuilt in this run.

functions.name: ProcessManager high-actors loop (proposal)
functions.known: Called by ProcessManager::Update 0x00678510 with (0, 0) as its fourth call (knowledge/threading.md, read). In the gate horde 2026-11-14 (run obng-profile-gate-guards/20261114-164228): 20.5 ms inclusive a call, 4.1 ms of it outside every timed callee; it calls the high update 0x00605770 once a high actor (175 a call). 27 distinct callees in the pseudocode, four calls of 0x00659A00.
questions: In what order the actors are taken, and whether an actor's turn reads anything an earlier actor's turn of the same call wrote
What the 4.1 ms outside the high update are: which callees run per actor besides 0x00605770, and which once a call

For the map of what may run on several threads (docs/subsystems/actor-frame-parallel.md): list every read and every write this function makes itself, grouped as (a) the actor / object it is called on (this and what hangs on it), (b) other actors or references, (c) the Havok world and its bodies and phantoms, (d) the engine's globals, singletons and shared lists - with the global's address, (e) the heap (allocations and frees, with the call). Name every callee with one line on what it is for, and mark which callees you did not follow.
